security_spec.violation_condition: QEMU does not implement a formal normative rule from the ISA spec (e.g., CSR field is not properly WARL-constrained, a required write side-effect is missing, or a reset value is incorrect), causing guest-visible behavior to diverge from the architectural specification
security_spec.summary: Normative rules formalize CSR WALR/WLRL constraints and side-effects; QEMU must match bit-exact or guest OS security assumptions (e.g., supervisor-level CSR access control, satp-write TLB invalidation) break silently
